sloka: अथ वा न हि तस्यार्थे धर्मकामस्य धीमतः ।मया रामस्य राजर्षेर्भार्यया परमात्मनः ।। ५.२४.४०।।।।
transliteration: atha vā na hi tasyārthe dharmakāmasya dhīmataḥ ।mayā rāmasya rājarṣerbhāryayā paramātmanaḥ ।। 5.24.40।।।।

translations.english: 'I have developed a morbid desire to feast upon this woman with eyes flashing like doe's, whose breasts heave with stress and fear after she was abducted by Ravana.
